description.es: Cloe y Marta hablan sobre ideas para el perfume. Con la excusa de una pestaña caída, Cloe le toca la cara a Marta. Luego le propone que recorran juntas Toledo para inspirarse para el nuevo perfume, y Marta acepta.
description.en: Cloe and Marta talk about ideas for the perfume. Using a fallen eyelash as an excuse, Cloe touches Marta's face. She then suggests they tour Toledo together to get inspiration for the new perfume, and Marta accepts.
